Tom Clancy's The Division: Recruited

Thomas Parrott's first Operation: Crossroads novel introduces Maira Kanhai's Division story in post-Green Poison Washington.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-28

Operation: Crossroads, book one

Recruited opens Thomas Parrott's licensed Operation: Crossroads sequence. It is an official Division transmedia novel, not a game mission or a replacement for game-source chronology. [1]

Published setup and timeline

The public setup follows Maira Kanhai from Washington's post-Green Poison civilian crisis toward SHD recruitment. Aconyte places that starting point after The Division 2, while the archive keeps the novel's later plot developments source-specific. [1][2]

Claim ledger

Every factual statement below must retain at least one traceable source.

  1. confirmed

    Recruited is Thomas Parrott's first Operation: Crossroads novel in the licensed Tom Clancy's The Division publishing line, released by Aconyte Books in 2022. [1]

  2. confirmed

    The official premise places Maira Kanhai in the aftermath of Green Poison in Washington, where a Division agent's death opens a path to recruitment while a threat targets the agency. [2]

  3. confirmed

    Aconyte's author interview describes Recruited as taking place after The Division 2, during a period when order is beginning to return to Washington without restoring normal life. [1]
